The '''Provider''' was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] produced by [[Barimoq Industries]]. With a range of one hundred and fifty meters and a capacity of four slugs, the rifle was traditionally used by the [[Tasari]] for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]].<ref name="J15" />
